Given integer values and valid inclusive index pairs [left,right], return one sum per query. With no queries return [].

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      2,
      -3,
      5,
      4
    ],
    [
      [
        0,
        2
      ],
      [
        2,
        3
      ],
      [
        1,
        1
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    4,
    9,
    -3
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [],
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

A zero-prefixed cumulative sum handles the left boundary cleanly.

Complexity: O(n+q) time, O(n+q) space
